sentences.en: The conclusion was formed on the basis of these facts.
sentences.zh: 这些事实的基础上得出了这个结论。

sentences.en: Since when are you two on a first name basis?
sentences.zh: 你们俩什么时候开始叫名字了？

sentences.en: Franklin's ideas formed the basis of the University of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林的想法构成了宾夕法尼亚大学的基础。

senses.zh: 基础，根据；基本原则，基本方法；根据，理由；基准
